record.t: Was elected to the Utah State Senate from District 10.
record.q: On Nov. 4, 2008, Senator Luz Escamilla, District 10, was elected to the Utah State Senate, becoming the first Latina elected in the Utah State Senate and the first immigrant elected in the Utah State Legislature.

record.office: Director, State Office of Ethnic Affairs
record.t: Was appointed by Governor Jon Huntsman as the first director of the State Office of Ethnic Affairs.
record.q: she was appointed by Governor Jon Huntsman in 2005 as the inaugural director of the State Office of Ethnic Affairs, overseeing Asian, Black, Hispanic/Latino, and Pacific Islander Affairs.

record.t: Serves as Minority Leader of the Utah State Senate in her fourth term.
record.q: Now in her fourth term, Senator Escamilla holds the position of Minority Leader, driving impactful change in legislative initiatives.
